output:
To: @marco
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Desert Palms — codes for the 14 units

Marco. You and I need to settle this about Saturday.

You rekeyed Desert Palms, 14 units, and I opened the code sheet this morning. There is not one bitting code in it. Yvette is standing at the leasing office with a tenant in 9B who lost her key and wants three copies, and I got nothing to cut from because I never got the codes.

This is the same thing you did on the Kessler job in September, and I told you then. I put it out to everybody in August — codes go in the sheet the same day, before you leave the van, address and code, no exceptions, and I don't care if it's nine at night. I said it wasn't optional and I meant it.

I'm not firing you. You're good with your hands and that's the reason I keep you on the truck. But this can't keep happening. A rekey without codes isn't a finished job, it's a job I have to go redo, and I'm the one eating it.

So here's today's list. You go back out to Desert Palms and decode 9B at minimum so Yvette can cut those keys. If you can get all 14, get all 14. Every one of them goes in the code sheet before you leave the lot, and you send me a picture of the page so I know it's done, not just claimed.

Second thing: bring my pinning tray back. You left it sitting in your office and Yvette found it on the leasing counter with pins in it. I don't want my tools sitting where a tenant or somebody walking by can pick them up.

I don't want to have this conversation a third time.

Ray

---

To: @lupe
Replying to: [i05]
Cc: none
Subject: Re: Desert Palms 9B keys

No, he never sent them, and nothing was in the sheet. I'll handle Marco — he's going back out there today to decode 9B so Yvette can cut those keys, and I'll have him in the sheet with all 14 codes before he leaves the property, including any he can't get to yet flagged by unit. I'll get the pinning tray back off the leasing counter too. Thanks for calling it in this morning.
